$ totaldays += 1
$ day += 1
scene bedroom_day
When the morning comes, the night prior feels as if it never even happened.
lines.zh: 清晨到来时，前一晚仿佛根本不曾发生过。

lines.en: Like it was all some sort of dream dreamt in advance before my subsequent slumber and an even more subsequent sea of black.
lines.zh: 就像一切都是在我随后的沉睡、以及更随后那片黑色海洋之前，提前做好的一场梦。

lines.en: The first thing I think about when I wake up is thanking my organs, though I’m not quite sure why.
lines.zh: 醒来后我想到的第一件事，是感谢我的器官，尽管我不太清楚为什么。

lines.en: Though, I know there must be some sort of correlation between the spontaneity of such a nonsensical desire and the much more sensical (Which isn’t actually a word for some reason) need to see Miku again.
lines.zh: 不过我知道，这种荒唐念头的自发涌现，和那个更有道理（不知为什么这其实不算个词）的、想再见 Miku 一面的需求之间，一定有某种关联。

lines.en: The second thought I have is that it might be time for a change of color.
lines.zh: 我的第二个念头是，也许是时候换个颜色了。

lines.en: I could paint my room. Or get a new shirt. Maybe even dye my hair and start my “bad boy” phase.
lines.zh: 我可以粉刷房间。或者买件新衬衫。甚至染个头发，开启我的“坏男孩”阶段。

lines.en: A third and mostly related thought is that something needs to change.
lines.zh: 第三个、也大致相关的念头是：有些事需要改变。

lines.en: A fourth is that something will.
lines.zh: 第四个是：有些事会改变。

lines.en: And a fifth is that I’m not sure if I’ll like it or not.
lines.zh: 第五个是：我不确定自己会不会喜欢。

lines.en: scene black
My sixth thought involves getting dressed.
lines.zh: 第六个念头跟穿衣服有关。

lines.en: The seventh, leaving the room.
lines.zh: 第七个，是走出房间。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter1
: Oh, good timing. I was just about to come get you and passive-aggressively ask why Miku is here to see you this early in the morning.
lines.zh: : 哦，来得早不如来得巧。我正准备去叫你，顺便阴阳怪气地问一句，Miku 为什么一大早就来找你。

lines.en: : That’s a good question, Ami...I was under the impression I was going to have to go see her.
lines.zh: : 这问题问得好，Ami……我还以为得我去看她呢。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Sorry if I’m gettin’ you in trouble, Sensei. I just...you know...wanted to talk about last night and stuff...
lines.zh: : 如果我给你惹了麻烦，那对不起，Sensei。我只是……那个……想聊聊昨晚的事什么的……

lines.en: : Well, I didn’t like that sentence one bit.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这句话我可一点都不喜欢。

lines.en: : It’s not like that, Ami. There was just-
lines.zh: : 不是你想的那样，Ami。只是——

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter2
: You don’t have to tell me, Sensei. I’m just being difficult because that’s what I’m used to doing.
lines.zh: : 你不用跟我解释，Sensei。我只是习惯性地刁难一下罢了。

lines.en: : I’ll leave you two alone. I have to go to work anyway. We just added a bunch of new menu items and Uta wants all of us to remember them by Tuesday.
lines.zh: : 我就不打扰你们俩了。反正我得去上班。我们刚加了一堆新菜品，Uta 要我们所有人在周二之前全部记住。

lines.en: : You’re going to just...leave me alone in the house with another girl?
lines.zh: : 你就这么……把我跟另一个女孩单独留在家里？

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter3
: It’s just Miku. It’s not like I’m leaving you here with Kirin or Noriko. Plus, everyone knows better than to show up for funny business with you while I’m home.
lines.zh: : 只是 Miku 而已。又不是把你跟 Kirin 或 Noriko 留在一起。再说了，我在家的时候，谁都知道不该来找你搞什么名堂。

lines.en: : The real risky ones are the girls who do it behind my back. So Miku actually gains points for asking me if she could come inside.
lines.zh: : 真正危险的是那些背着我来的女孩。所以 Miku 还问了问我能不能进屋，这反倒给她加了分。

lines.en: : Not like she needs or wants them, though. This is probably just to clear up some sort of misunderstanding, right?
lines.zh: : 不过她大概既不需要也不想要这些分。这次大概只是为了澄清什么误会吧？

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter4
: I’m not really sure if...“misunderstanding” is the right word, but...I ain’t lyin’ when I say I’m not here for any sorta funny business.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定“误会”这个词对不对，不过……我说我不是来搞什么名堂的，这可一点没骗你。

lines.en: : Well, all I can really do is take your word for it. So, whatever is going on, I hope you two can figure it out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我能做的也只有相信你了。所以不管出了什么事，我希望你们俩能处理好。

lines.en: : Until then, I have like five soups and a few drinks to memorize.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我还有五种汤和几种饮料要背。

lines.en: : That doesn’t seem like that many, Ami.
lines.zh: : 听着也不算多啊，Ami。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter5
: Then I’ll be back before there’s even a chance for any funny business.
lines.zh: : 那我会在你们有机会搞名堂之前就回来的。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter6
: Breakfast is in the fridge and coffee is already brewed! Have a nice day, Sensei! I love you!
lines.zh: : 早餐在冰箱里，咖啡也煮好了！祝你今天愉快，Sensei！我爱你！

lines.en: Ami...leaves the house.
lines.zh: Ami……出门了。

lines.en: And suddenly, there are two girls I need to bring to the doctor.
lines.zh: 而突然间，我有了两个需要带去看医生的女孩。

lines.en: : So, how are we tackling this? Because, based on the way you’ve been nervously fidgeting since I came out of my bedroom, I doubt you’re going to be yelling at me again.
lines.zh: : 那么，我们怎么处理这事？因为看我从卧室出来之后你就一直紧张地动来动去，我猜你不会再冲我喊了吧。

lines.en: : Course I ain’t gonna yell at you, Sensei. Shouldn’t have yelled at ya last night either. That’s kinda the first thing I wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 我当然不会再冲你喊了，Sensei。昨晚也不该冲你喊的。这大概就是我最想说的第一件事。

lines.en: : Well, go ahead. You can take the reins on this one. I’ll just stand here and figure out what I’m supposed to do with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你继续。这次你来主导。我就站在这儿，想想该拿你怎么办。

lines.en: : Yeah...yeah, that’s...fair...
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，这……挺公平的……

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter7
: Hahah...this...this feels kind of familiar, right? You remember the first time you found out about my...brain thingy? And how I had to apologize back then too?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……这……这感觉有点似曾相识，对吧？你还记得你第一次知道我的那个……脑子毛病的时候吗？那时候我也得跟你道歉。

lines.en: : I do. But I also remember that I’m the one who visited you back then.
lines.zh: : 记得。不过我也记得，那次是我去看的你。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter8
: And I was surprised you did...
lines.zh: : 你会来，我很意外……

lines.en: : Kinda figured you’d want nothin’ to do with me after freakin’ out on ya like that.
lines.zh: : 我那样冲你发疯之后，我还以为你再也不想理我了呢。

lines.en: : But...it’s been a long time since then and...it might not seem like it to you, but I think I’ve changed a lot. And you and me are...a lot closer now. Even if it’s just...you know...in a naughty way...
lines.zh: : 不过……那已经是很久以前的事了，而且……你也许看不出来，但我觉得我变了很多。而且你和我……现在近多了。哪怕只是……那个……在那种色色的意义上……

lines.en: : It’s not just that, Miku.
lines.zh: : 不只是那样，Miku。

lines.en: : I know, yeah. Yeah. But, like...what I’m sayin’ is...I’m like...
lines.zh: : 我知道，嗯。嗯。不过……我想说的是……我好像……

lines.en: : I trust you now...and stuff...and just sittin’ around and waitin’ for you to come to me gives me all sorts of...butterflies and...yeah...
lines.zh: : 我现在信任你了……什么的……光是坐在这儿等你来找我，我就会涌起各种各样的……小鹿乱撞……然后……嗯……

lines.en: : To tell ya the truth, I’ve actually been wanderin’ around your neighborhood for, like...four or five hours or something.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我在你家附近已经晃了……大概四五个小时之类的。

lines.en: : What? It’s only like 9:00 AM.
lines.zh: : 什么？现在才早上九点吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...I couldn’t really sleep.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我实在睡不着。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter9
: But I was nice enough to let you sleep in, so...I didn’t do anything wrong. Right? I just couldn’t really...you know...
lines.zh: : 不过我还是够意思地让你睡到自然醒，所以……我没做错什么吧？我只是实在没法……那个……

lines.en: : Waiting is...
lines.zh: : 等待是……

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter10
: Sensei, I’m really sorry. I’m sorry I keep puttin’ you in positions like this because of the kinda girl I am.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我真的很抱歉。抱歉我总是因为我这种性格，把你推到这样的处境里。

lines.en: : This position is a little different from that first one, Miku. This is way more serious.
lines.zh: : 这次的处境跟第一次可不太一样，Miku。这次严重多了。

lines.en: : I know, I know. That first time, you could’ve given me a pass or somethin’. But this time, I’ve gotta apologize because this time I actually messed up. Like, a lot.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。第一次的时候，你大可以当没发生过。可这次我必须道歉，因为这次我是真的搞砸了。而且是搞砸得特别厉害。

lines.en: : It ain’t like I’m gettin’ all weird because of my...condition. I blamed you for a thing you didn’t have anythin’ to do with and that was all sortsa messed up in a million different ways.
lines.zh: : 这可不像我因为那个……毛病才变得怪里怪气的。我把一件跟你毫无关系的事怪到你头上，这在一百万个层面上都错得离谱。

lines.en: : I know you were just tryin’ to help. And even if it was you who took everythin’ away, I shouldn’t have gone off on ya like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道你只是想帮忙。而且就算真的是你把一切都拿走的，我也不该那样冲你发火。

lines.en: : You’re giving me too much credit, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你太抬举我了，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter11
: What do you mean by “givin’ you too much credit?”
lines.zh: : “太抬举你”是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that saying I was just trying to help is making me sound a lot better than I actually am when I shrugged this off time and time again.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我说“只是想帮忙”，把自己说得比实际好太多了——毕竟我一次又一次地对此不以为意。

lines.en: : If I really wanted to help, I would have done something sooner.
lines.zh: : 如果我真想帮忙，早该做点什么了。

lines.en: : That ain’t true. Buttin’ into somebody else’s life ain’t always easy, Sensei. I ain’t gonna blame you for not doin’ somethin’ earlier. I’m sure you had your reasons.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢。插手别人的人生可不总是件容易的事，Sensei。我不会怪你怎么不早点做点什么。我相信你有你的理由。

lines.en: : But the point is...I get how dangerous what I was doin’ was now. And I ain’t gonna do it anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过重点是……我现在明白自己做的事有多危险了。而且我不会再做了。

lines.en: : Maki’s gonna take me to a real doctor and...I’m gonna figure out where to go from there.
lines.zh: : Maki 会带我去看真正的医生，然后……我会想清楚接下来该怎么办。

lines.en: : Sounds like a lot has happened in the last twelve hours, huh?
lines.zh: : 听起来这十二个小时里发生了不少事啊？

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter12
: Friggin’ tell me about it.
lines.zh: : 还他妈用你说。

lines.en: : No. You tell me about it. What did happen after I left last night?
lines.zh: : 不。你来说给我听。昨晚我走了之后到底发生了什么？

lines.en: scene black
Miku agrees to open up about what happened when Makoto came home, and the two of us make our way over to the couch...
lines.zh: Miku 答应把 Makoto 回家后发生的事和盘托出，于是我们俩挪到了沙发那边……

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter13
There’s a moment of silence when we get there, but it’s no different from the hundreds of other moments of silence I’ve had before hundreds of other difficult conversations.
lines.zh: 到了那边之后有片刻的沉默，但这跟我此前在无数次艰难对话之前经历过的无数次沉默没什么两样。

lines.en: And while Miku’s managed to avoid most of those, she does have her moments every now and then. It’s just hard for her to have more substantial ones when she’s still so secretive about everything.
lines.zh: 虽然 Miku 大多时候都能避开这些沉默，但她偶尔也有自己的时刻。只是当她对一切都守口如瓶时，很难有更实质性的时刻。

lines.en: I don’t blame her for that. How could I? I’m just noting that it makes things harder.
lines.zh: 我不怪她。我怎么会怪她呢？我只是想说，这让事情变得更难。

lines.en: But no one said this would be easy. No one said any of this would be easy, and I’m learning more and more of exactly what that means every single day.
lines.zh: 可没人说过这会容易。没人说过这一切会容易，而我每一天都在越来越明白这句话到底是什么意思。

lines.en: There’s likely nothing I can do to help her. But I can listen.
lines.zh: 我大概什么都帮不了她。但我可以倾听。

lines.en: And sometimes, that’s all a person needs.
lines.zh: 而有时候，这就是一个人所需的全部。

lines.en: : Without beatin’ around the bush, nobody took anythin’ from me at all. I just...kinda forgot where I put the bag Io gave me.
lines.zh: : 不绕弯子了，根本没有人拿走我什么东西。我只是……有点忘了 Io 给我的那个袋子放哪儿了。

lines.en: : I had a bad episode before school that day, so I took a little too much to try and calm myself down and...must’ve put what was left somewhere I wasn’t exactly used to or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 那天上学前我发作得挺厉害，所以就多吃了点想让自己平静下来，然后……大概把剩下的放到一个我不常放东西的地方之类的。

lines.en: : But...that ain’t gonna be a problem anymore since Makoto found it before I was able to and gave me the lecture of a friggin’ lifetime.
lines.zh: : 不过……这不会再是问题了，因为 Makoto 先我一步找到了它，然后把我训了个狗血淋头。

lines.en: Ah...so it wasn’t a change of heart for Io after all.
lines.zh: 啊……所以 Io 根本不是回心转意了。

lines.en: I should have known.
lines.zh: 我早该想到的。

lines.en: : So Makoto knows now?
lines.zh: : 所以 Makoto 现在知道了？

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter14
: I told her everythin’ except where I was gettin’ ‘em.
lines.zh: : 除了我从哪儿弄到的，我把一切都告诉她了。

lines.en: : I didn’t wanna throw Io under the bus like that when she’s got enough goin’ on.
lines.zh: : 她本来就够烦的了，我不想那样把 Io 卖了。

lines.en: : And how did Makoto take that?
lines.zh: : 那 Makoto 听了之后什么反应？

lines.en: : She was shocked. Cried a lot. Asked me a bunch of questions I had a hard time answerin’ since I was panickin’ the whole time.
lines.zh: : 她很震惊。哭了很久。问了我一堆问题，我全程都在恐慌，所以很难答上来。

lines.en: : Seein’ her like that started to calm me down, though. Felt like I was bein’ a...huge disappointment after all she’s done for me. So I just started spillin’ out my guts all rapid-fire like.
lines.zh: : 不过看到她那样，我反倒开始冷静下来了。感觉在她为我做了那么多之后，我成了个……巨大的失望。于是我就开始噼里啪啦地把心里话全倒了出来。

lines.en: : She flushed the leftover medicine down the toilet and called Maki to make an appointment thingy for me. Didn’t even care that I didn’t wanna talk to them. Just didn’t want me to get hurt.
lines.zh: : 她把剩下的药冲进了马桶，还打电话给 Maki 帮我约了号。她根本不在乎我不想跟他们说，只是不想让我受伤。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter15
: I left you out of it too, ya know. Far as Makoto’s concerned, you were just in the wrong place at the wrong time.
lines.zh: : 我也把你摘出去了，你知道吧。在 Makoto 看来，你只是在错误的时间出现在了错误的地点。

lines.en: : I doubt she’s going to buy that I wasn’t at least partially involved in this. She’s too smart for that.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑她不会相信我在这件事里至少没掺和一点。她太聪明了。

lines.en: : You really weren’t, though. All ya did was try and talk me out of it. You tried talkin’ Io out of it too, didn’t ya? So why do you keep blamin’ yourself for this?
lines.zh: : 可你真的没有。你做的一切就是试着劝我别干。你也试着劝过 Io，不是吗？那你干嘛一直为这事自责？

lines.en: : Because I’m an adult. It’s my responsibility to do something about stuff like this if I’m made aware of it.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个成年人。既然我知道了这种事，就有责任做点什么。

lines.en: : The heck’s bein’ an adult have to do with anythin’? People are people and talkin’ to other people can get pretty hard. You ain’t responsible for me.
lines.zh: : 成年人和这有什么关系啊？人就是人，跟别人开口本来就不容易。你不用对我负责。

lines.en: : I literally am. I’m your teacher.
lines.zh: : 从字面上说我还真得负责。我是你的老师。

lines.en: : But you’re also my friend, ain’t ya? And that’s the sorta thing most friends who aren’t named Makoto would have a tough time dealin’ with.
lines.zh: : 可你也是我的朋友啊，不是吗？而这件事，换作大多数不叫 Makoto 的朋友，都很难处理。

lines.en: : Only one to blame here is me. I’m an idiot and didn’t realize what I was gettin’ myself into. But thanks to you guys, I’m gonna try and be better from now on. Promise.
lines.zh: : 该怪的只有我自己。我是个傻子，根本没意识到自己卷进了什么。不过多亏了你们，从现在起我会努力变好。我保证。

lines.en: : Is there anything you need from me?
lines.zh: : 你有什么需要我做的吗？

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter16
: If there’s any way I can help, just tell me. I’m obviously no doctor- and if you want to absolve me of my partial responsibility for what happened, fine. But if there’s anything I can do-
lines.zh: : 只要我能帮上忙，尽管开口。我显然不是医生——而且如果你想免掉我对这件事的部分责任，也随你。但凡有我能做的——

lines.en: : There...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter17
: Okay, so...
lines.zh: : 好吧，那个……

lines.en: : Remember how I was talkin’ about how far we’ve come and how much I’ve changed and...and how much I trust you and all that?
lines.zh: : 还记得我刚才说我们走了多远、我变了多少、还有……我有多信任你那些话吗？

lines.en: : That wasn’t all that long ago, so...yeah. I remember.
lines.zh: : 那也没过多久，所以……嗯，我记得。

lines.en: : Well...um...
: Uhh...
scene mikuvisitafter18
: There...there ain’t a lot of people who know about...why I’m like this...and why I ain’t good at talkin’ about it or...how I kinda can’t talk about it...
lines.zh: : 那个……知道我为什么会变成这样、为什么我不擅长说这件事、或者说……我根本说不出来的人，没几个……

lines.en: : But if I’m gonna be ruinin’ your life all the time like I have been, I think I owe it to you to at least try...especially if they’re gonna make me tell this story to doctors and stuff soon...
lines.zh: : 可如果我还要像现在这样一直搅乱你的生活，我觉得至少该试试看……尤其是他们很快就要让我把这个故事讲给医生什么的听了……

lines.en: : Are you sure you want to tell me?
lines.zh: : 你确定想告诉我吗？

lines.en: : No. But if you keep askin’ me questions like that, chances are I’m never gonna. I can’t have an option when it comes to this. I’ve gotta just...I’ve gotta do it. I’ve gotta tell you.
lines.zh: : 不确定。可你要是再这么问我，我大概永远都说不出口了。这种事不能给我留退路。我只能……我只能去做。我必须告诉你。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter19
: When I...
lines.zh: : 在我……

lines.en: : Umm...
: Uhh...
: Sorry...it’s been years since I’ve had to...I don’t even know how to...
lines.zh: : 对不起……我已经好多年没需要……我都不知道该怎么……

lines.en: : Take your time. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 慢慢来。没关系。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter20
: Hah...
scene black
: When I was little...
lines.zh: : 在我还小的时候……

lines.en: : Two men broke into my house.
lines.zh: : 有两个男人闯进了我家。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter21
: I don’t know about this...maybe we should leave?
lines.zh: : 我觉得不太对劲……要不我们走吧？

lines.en: : I got out of bed to get a drink of water or...
lines.zh: : 我起床想去喝点水，或者……

lines.en: : Or maybe it was milk or...
lines.zh: : 也可能是牛奶，或者……

lines.en: : No. No, the drink doesn’t matter. But I got out of bed, walked down the hallway and...
lines.zh: : 不。不，喝什么不重要。重要的是我下了床，走过走廊，然后……

lines.en: : And there they were.
lines.zh: : 然后他们就在那儿。

lines.en: : And do what? Go back home and go to sleep like we didn’t break into someone’s fucking house? Just be quiet and take as much as you can.
lines.zh: : 然后干什么？回家睡觉，就当我们没闯进别人他妈的家里？闭嘴，能拿多少拿多少。

lines.en: : Since I had just woken up, I wasn’t able to see really well, but...I could tell something was wrong.
lines.zh: : 因为我刚睡醒，看不太清楚，不过……我能感觉到有什么不对劲。

lines.en: : They’ve got a kid...
lines.zh: : 他们家还有个孩子……

lines.en: : My dad...had friends over a lot. So at first I thought it might just be some of them, but...
lines.zh: : 我爸爸……经常有朋友来家里。所以一开始我还以为只是他的一些朋友，可是……

lines.en: : So do I. But if I don’t come up with enough money by the end of the week, that could change.
lines.zh: : 我也是。不过要是这周结束前我凑不出足够的钱，那就不一定了。

lines.en: : We don’t have time for questions and observations. Just take anything that might be valuable. Now.
lines.zh: : 我们没时间问东问西了。值钱的东西全拿走。现在就动手。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter22
: I...I think I heard one of them say something about...about taking our stuff, so...
lines.zh: : 我……我好像听到其中一个说了什么……关于拿走我们家东西的话，所以……

lines.en: : So I tried to be quiet and go tell my...my parents, but...
lines.zh: : 所以我就想悄悄去告诉我的……我爸妈，可是……

lines.en: : I think...I think they might have heard me...or...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我觉得他们可能听见我了……或者……

lines.en: : Did you hear something just now?
lines.zh: : 你刚才听到什么了吗？

lines.en: : Whatever it was is gone now. So put the fucking frame down and start going through their drawers.
lines.zh: : 不管是什么，现在已经没了。把那个该死的相框放下，开始翻他们的抽屉。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter23
: When I made it into their room, I shook them awake...I told them...I told them there were people in our house...
lines.zh: : 等我进了他们的房间，我把他们摇醒……我告诉他们……我告诉他们我们家里有外人……

lines.en: : And at first, they didn’t believe me. We...weren’t rich or anything, so...why would anyone...uh...
lines.zh: : 一开始他们不信。我们……又不是什么有钱人，所以……为什么会有人……呃……

lines.en: : Anyway...uhh...umm...
: When...when they finally heard something in the...living room or...maybe it was the kitchen? Or...
lines.zh: : 等他们终于听到……客厅里有什么动静，或者……也许是厨房？还是……

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter24
: My dad...he...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我爸爸……他……呃……

lines.en: : When the sounds...happened, he...
lines.zh: : 那些声音……响起的时候，他……

lines.en: : The door and...
lines.zh: : 门，还有……

lines.en: : And there was yelling and...
lines.zh: : 然后有人在喊，还有……

lines.en: : And my mom had me hide under the bed and...
lines.zh: : 然后我妈妈让我躲到床底下，然后……

lines.en: : There was more yelling and...then a bang...
lines.zh: : 然后是更多的喊声，然后……砰的一声……

lines.en: : Then another and...
lines.zh: : 然后又一声，然后……

lines.en: : And the yelling got quieter...and quieter...
lines.zh: : 喊声越来越小……越来越小……

lines.en: : And quieter...
lines.zh: : 越来越小……

lines.en: : And...and then it stopped...
lines.zh: : 然后……然后就没声了……

lines.en: : So I...from under the bed...I...
lines.zh: : 于是我……从床底下……我……

lines.en: : Then...the living room and...
lines.zh: : 然后……客厅，然后……

lines.en: : And they were...
lines.zh: : 然后他们……

lines.en: : Both of them were...
lines.zh: : 他们两个都……

lines.en: : I was...I couldn’t...
lines.zh: : 我……我做不到……

lines.en: : I kept trying to wake them up...
lines.zh: : 我一直试着把他们摇醒……

lines.en: : I didn’t believe it...I still don’t...I don’t understand...
lines.zh: : 我不敢相信……到现在还是不敢……我不明白……

lines.en: : Why us?...What did we do wrong?...
lines.zh: : 为什么是我们？……我们做错了什么？……

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter25
: Was it my fault?...
lines.zh: : 是我的错吗？……

lines.en: : If I never woke up...If I never got thirsty...If I was quieter...
lines.zh: : 要是我没醒来……要是我没觉得渴……要是我更安静一点……

lines.en: : Then maybe...maybe they would...
lines.zh: : 那么也许……也许他们就会……

lines.en: : It’s not your fault, Miku...
lines.zh: : 这不是你的错，Miku……

lines.en: : But...because of me...all of this happened...because of me...
lines.zh: : 可是……因为我……这一切才发生的……都是因为我……

lines.en: : There is no “because of” anyone. Some things just happen without a reason.
lines.zh: : 没有什么“因为谁”。有些事就是毫无理由地发生了。

lines.en: : My mom...and dad...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈……和爸爸……

lines.en: : For no reason?...
lines.zh: : 毫无理由？……

lines.en: : None?...
lines.zh: : 一点都没有？……

lines.en: : I don’t know. There’s nothing I can say here to make you feel any better.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。在这儿我说什么都没法让你好受一点。

lines.en: : All I can do here is listen.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿能做的只有倾听。

lines.en: : But I’m glad you finally told me.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你终于告诉了我。

lines.en: scene mikuvisitafter26
: That’s why...any time I hear a loud noise, I...
lines.zh: : 所以……每次我听到巨大的声响，我……

lines.en: : It’s like I’m back there...
lines.zh: : 就好像回到了那里……

lines.en: : In my old house...
lines.zh: : 回到我以前的家……

lines.en: : Trying to wake them up...
lines.zh: : 试着把他们摇醒……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But they never do...
lines.zh: : 可他们从来没有醒过……

lines.en: : I just want it to stop.
lines.zh: : 我只想让它停下来。

lines.en: : I want to stop going back there.
lines.zh: : 我想不要再回到那里。

lines.en: : I need help.
lines.zh: : 我需要帮助。

lines.en: : You’ll get help if you’re willing to admit that. Maki will make sure of it. Makoto too.
lines.zh: : 只要你愿意承认这一点，你就会得到帮助。Maki 会保证的。Makoto 也是。

lines.en: : I’m a burden to them. They’ve done so much for me and all I am is a burden to them.
lines.zh: : 我是她们的负担。她们为我做了那么多，而我对她们而言只是个负担。

lines.en: : Don’t feel too bad about that. I’m a burden to everyone around me and I’m able to live with myself just fine.
lines.zh: : 别太为这个难过。我对身边所有人来说都是个负担，不也照样活得心安理得。

lines.en: : Can I use your bathroom please?
lines.zh: : 我能用一下你的洗手间吗？

lines.en: : Only if you promise you’re not going to pull your hair out in there.
lines.zh: : 只要你保证不会在里面扯自己的头发。

lines.en: : Then can I use your bed?
lines.zh: : 那我可以用你的床吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Miku...
lines.zh: : 可以，Miku……

lines.en: scene black
: You can use my bed.
lines.zh: : 你可以用我的床。

lines.en: I sit on the floor as Miku sobs herself to sleep for the first time in over twenty-four hours.
lines.zh: 我坐在地板上，看着 Miku 哭着哭着睡着了——这是二十四个小时以来她的第一次睡眠。

lines.en: And I silently applaud her for being much stronger than I am at less than half my age.
lines.zh: 而我在心里默默为她鼓掌：不到我一半的年纪，却比我坚强得多。

lines.en: The mystery’s been solved. And even though some of the details are still a little fuzzy, that’s okay.
lines.zh: 谜团解开了。虽然有些细节仍然有点模糊，但没关系。

lines.en: I don’t need to know everything.
lines.zh: 我不需要知道一切。

lines.en: Because what I do know now is more than I deserve.
lines.zh: 因为我现在所知道的，已经超出了我配得上的。

lines.en: But it’s enough to make me want to stand by her every step of the way.
lines.zh: 但它足以让我想要在她身边的每一步都陪着她走下去。

lines.en: Even if I have to walk on glass.
lines.zh: 哪怕我得踩着碎玻璃前行。

lines.en: $ mikudorm55p2 = True
$ miku_love += 10
Miku’s affection has increased by 10!
lines.zh: Miku 的好感度提升了 10！

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
When Ami comes home, I thank her for leaving Miku and me alone today.
lines.zh: Ami 回家时，我谢了她今天把我和 Miku 单独留下。

lines.en: She returns the favor with samples of five different types of soup and a hug that lasts the rest of the night.
lines.zh: 她回敬给我五种不同汤的试吃，还有一个持续了整个晚上的拥抱。

lines.en: scene black
jump advancetomon
